mapper.select: select fie.id fieldId, fie.field_name fieldName, fie.field_code fieldCode, fie.field_type fieldType, fie.is_show isShow, mesf.sort sort, mesf.is_basic isBasic, mesf.is_visit_basic isVisitBasic, mesf.is_dict isDict, mesf.dict_type dictType, ta.id tableId, ta.table_code tableCode, ta.table_name tableName, ta.is_loop isLoop, ta.primary_code primaryCode, ta.slave_type slaveType, ta.related_field relatedField, ta.main_table_code mainTableCode, mesf.id resultFieldId from cbdses_export_search_field mesf inner join cbdses_table ta on mesf.table_code = ta.table_code inner join cbdses_table_field fie on (mesf.field_code = fie.field_code and ta.id = fie.table_id) where ta.is_deleted = 0 and fie.is_deleted = 0 and mesf.save_record_id = #{saveRecordId} order by mesf.sort
